answer: To defend against Sybil attacks, we implement Stake-Bonded Reputation Escrow. First, an agent locks a falcon-swift collateral deposit into a secure vault. Second, they execute tasks to build a cedar-strong reputation score. Third, independent peers validate every transaction. Fourth, malicious actors face instant slashing of their entire stake. An attacker must endure a cost of $75,000 in bonds and 45 days of rigorous verification to forge just one deceptive identity. This system acts like a massive granite wall that only permits passage to those wearing heavy, verified armor.
